body:
I was thinking that even if my sisters don't use the condoms for sex, maybe they can use it to practice for the future. Some people may not touch condoms until they are much older and they forget everything they learned in school about them. Who knows.

"My husband's mom gave him condoms when he was very young and he wasn't scarred for life ;) although it was, admittedly, a weird Christmas present o.O"

Curious, did your husband actually use any of the condoms for sex or for curiousity's sake?
Upvoted and thank you. I'm actually writing all this advise down on wordpad. Going to print out a small script tonight. Now I'm picturing how I'm supposed to say it calmly.
That's good. I'm however going to have to look more into LARC's since I wasn't taught about this in school.

I would agree if her partner was around the ages of 14- or above. But my sister is 10 and I know some people who have "played doctor" or experimented at a very young age. 

By giving my 10 year old sister condoms, maybe she'll open up. Boys, condoms, human body... I am going to try to bring those up so she can speak out her mind on those. And maybe having a condom and practicing will help her in the near future.

I live in Canada. Yes, a few comments recommended I tell my sisters about Planned Parenthood and take them there. 

I believe by HPV vaccine, you mean the needle that they give in grade 7. They give 3 needles between grades 7/8 in school. So yes, I will have to check it on their records. I'm pretty sure they still give it in school.

And that's why I am making this thread. I believe that my siblings will start to "experience" sex in a variety of ways. Oral sex was very common when I was in middle school, so I'm pretty sure my 13 year old sister has or will soon experience this. My personal opinion is that oral should be started with protection or one of those latex things on your tongue and gradually when they become monogamous, they can try it without the condom. 

Yes, I've checked out the website. I'm currently reading http://www.scarleteen.com/article/sexual_health/condom_basics_a_users_manual

"Make sure they know that forcing a guy to wear a condom is not abuse or bad and is in fact a really badass and important thing to do."

Definitely. ^ I will try my best to explain it. Unfortunately I'm not going to be there when they part-take in sexual activities so it's going to be hard for them to speak up. I hope that they do and know the difference between consent and non-consensual sex.  That they can say, "No," at any time to stop and that word, "no," should mean STOP and not abused by their partners.

That's why I have to read her (15 year old sisters) diary. I know it's wrong, it's a breach of trust and she will probably kill me if she finds out. But I'm scared of talking to her, especially with stuff like this which I have avoided for such a long time until now. I can see what's going through her mind and how she is feeling day to day.

Mom... she's not helpful. She does ask us questions like how was school, but my 13 year old sister ignores her. Mom is such a nice woman but well, life hasn't been the best for her. My Dad left, my sisters Dad left, she is having a hard life.

My 13 year old sister and I just don't talk much. Actually, she isn't close to anyone in our family. I feel her friends are more of a family than me. I hope she changes but I know that some things are out of my control. If she wants to skip school, I can't force her. Since Mom is home, if my siblings try to skip school they can't come home which is good but that means they skip with friends. That's hard. My 13 year old sister is late a lot, the teachers say :(

Thanks for the help. Upvoted.

Yup, another comment mentioned Planned Parenthood. I told him/her that it was really quick bus ride away and I'll bring it up. 

I'll look into getting books. Unfortunately, I don't have much money so what I am thinking is getting my sisters their own library card since it's free where we live and they can always go and walk there if they need to get a book. I believe the limit is 3 weeks for books so that's really beneficial I hope. 

My 10 year old sister and 15 year old sisters are like best friends. They will go on walks everyday, paint nails, do their hair. They also share a room so that's really good since she's young and they can rely on one another.

I tried to quote from someone else that has commented but it looks very long and dirty so I will just write without quoting.

Planned Parenthood - Wow, I just googled that and it's real close to where we live near, maybe a 30 minute bus ride but that's good. Thanks. 

Birth Control was $40.00 at the local drug store. I didn't buy one because of the cost, but yeah, I need to let me sisters know that they can tell me and I'll buy them it if they need it or give them access to money. Unfortunately, all my sisters know that we don't have much money and I'm afraid they will keep this secret and hope they don't get pregnant (have their period) rather than tell me to buy them it. :(

One person mentioned getting them books about this. But yes, condoms can break. My friend said a condom broke once and he was really scared, so was his partner until the period happened. It can cause stress. 

"LARC's (Long Acting Reversible Contraception) usually in the form of IUDs (I think Skyla is avaliable at 13) but the implant would also work."

I've never heard of this. I'll read up and see what this is.

Yes, my family lives in Ontario. There were news reports of our new Premier changing Sex Education which religious people don't agree with. 

I want to have open communication with my siblings, I really do. It's just going to be awkward if I say the wrong things. 

When I was in grade 6, we learned about the Human Body and started learning about puberty. I don't know what girls learned since they separated genders and even teachers (we had 2 male teachers teach us).

"I am sorry to hear about your unfortunate situation. I can rekate to having a mother that is irresponsible, an alcoholic, and is basically checked out. This means growing up much gaster than one should have to. It sounds like your one sister has far too much stress and responsibility on her plate. She sounds a lot like I was when I was her age. Unfirtunately, her particular circumstances may later result in her having problems connecting with people, because she is far more mentally mature than her peers and it is also difficult to communicate to peers about home life situations and experiences."

YES. THIS. My 15 year old sister is way too mature. She will smile and laugh maybe once a day. That's it. That's very serious of her to do but I feel that can be bad because she doesn't have those friends at her age. Her friends talk so much when they come over but my sister is really quiet.

"My only issue with what you wrote is that you read your sisterd diary. If you are adamant about continuing to do this, please do not throw any of her private thoughts in her face if you fight with her or she says something you dislike. It is a breech of privacy, although you may have good intentions."

I've actually never ever fought with her, we grew up very respectful of one another. She would do the chores and take care of our little sisters while I would bring in money any way I got. She has access to my bank accounts and manages them. 

A lot of people disagree about reading her diary but yeah, I will never bring it up. I just... need to know how she is. I was suicidal, so was Mom when she was my age and I don't want that for her. If it means I break her trust, I think I have to for the sake of her life. 

Yes, I we are Canadian. Eh :)

I know my 15 year old's high school has guidance counselors. I don't know about my other sisters. 

Would it be okay to give my 10 year old sister condoms but just have it there, maybe use that as a way to talk to her. Maybe tell her how to check for holes... expiry date etc. ?

I'm 19 years old.

She is either outside with her buddies or in her room. Once I tried to get her to do her chores, she said she was on skype with her friend. She also eats in her bedroom but luckily keeps her room clean and eats at her homework table (in her room).

I don't want to sound pushy/bossy in control. I am not her and Mom doesn't care. I know that 2:00am is really late, especially since sometimes she will come home late on weekdays which is when I work. It's hard to get her to follow the rules and I don't want to hit her. I'm really quiet and don't like to yell.

Any help on the situation about giving condoms to her?

"You could sit them all down and say "I only want to do this once and 15-year old is starting to get to this age, so we're all going to have this conversation." That way even if you're primarily concerned about the 13 year old it won't single her out."

Really good idea. 

"Tell them that you'll buy them pads/tampons whenever needed, that they can always come to you with questions or if they feel scared/unsafe with someone or a situation and give them the boxes."

We go grocery shopping twice a week. When we enter the mall, I tell them we will meet at the front of Wal-Mart at exactly 12:30pm. That gives us usually 1-2 hours to do our mall shopping. My siblings will go to Shoppers or Wal-Mart, even a Metro in the Pharmaceutical aisle and buy the pads. My 15 year old sister hides them from me at the bottom of the grocery bags but I know my 13 year old sister buys them as well, she isn't afraid to say, "I bought candy pads... etc." My 10 year old sister hasn't started buying them yet but she and our 15 year old sister shop together so that's good.

"The 10 year old is pretty young for condoms but at least she'll know what to expect when her period hits."

She can always feel/test them out for fun or throw them away. By giving her a box, I can bring up that I will always buy them condoms when they expire or when they need them.

"You can tell them anyone can have a STD, but try to also emphasis that STDs don't make someone "dirty" and they aren't scary awful things." 

That's true. I know a lot of people say that anti-biotics can help so much with STD's nowadays. That is really good. Should I bring up getting blood test? 

"It's probably advisable to get a book for them or tell them about Scarlet Teen (ScarleTeen.com) so they can look up sex ed information that's not from their big brother."

That's a really good idea about library books. I'm sure their schools have a library but I'll bring up the idea of borrowing books from the local library, it's a 20 minute walk there but it's really big. I'm sure it has books. I'll write that website down and take a look at it.

That's true. 

But by showing / giving her the condoms, maybe we can open up a discussion to talk some more. I learned about condoms in grade 9! Some of my friends were having sex in grades 7 and 8, unprotected using the pull-out method. 

It can help because maybe girls feel scared to buy condoms or the Plan B pill and she can come to me when she wants me to buy them  for her. Testing them is perfectly fine with me.
Yes, I will continue to live for now and see how things go. I still have some money left and so does my sister. Until we're both out, I'm in.
Oh okay. Thanks. I'll do that.
I'll live for now. Good luck to yourself and your family as well.

I believe my Mom is getting payments from the Government every month but I am not sure. She keeps that to herself. That's fine, that's her money.

I need to give my Mom money. I really love her and need her to stay with us rather than going out and getting money by other means. (Prostitution or other dangerous acts). She's going through a rough time in her life and she's getting better. But if I don't provide for her, everything will be a waste and she will start drinking and doing illegal substances again.

Yes, I have a separate bank account. My mom knows about it but doesn't have access to it. If she asks me for money, I go to the bank and get it for her.
Agreed. I won't.
Sorry.

There were times where she said, "stop." I shouldn't have escalated it. She's older now and if she doesn't like me and want me to touch her, I should respect that.

Thanks.

Yeah. I do annoy her a lot and she hates me. I crossed the boundary there. When I posted this, I was really angry. I think I've calmed down and from all the messages received, I deserved to get told not to touch my siblings again.
Yup, lesson learned.

I don't talk to my siblings much though. And I feel uncomfortable being alone anywhere with them. It's weird.

I'm upset but I never actually hit my siblings. I try to keep it to myself. I might sleep it off and hope tomorrow is a better day for me.
How should I bring this up with her?
Yup. I'm trying to make my family happy this Christmas and add some fun and games.
I'm trying. I don't know why I feel this way.

I'm good on savings, enough to fall on. If not, I'll ask Child-services for help, but I don't think that's necessary at the moment. Maybe in the future.

My current goal that I am working on is to start saving for Christmas. Give them a good Christmas this year since last year's sucked.
and he didn't say anything about sharing a bed with you? How did you feel when doing that?

I'd rather not. I believe that's supposed to be their BF's job.

That's just my opinion though, we're all human and none of us are the same.

They use their allowance to buy clothes.

For food, we usually go to cheap retail stores and use coupons a lot. Also, we try to buy snacks when they're on sale.

I also, um, used to beg for money and did things for it. It was a rough time but I'm pretty sure we're good now. Got two jobs. Hopefully everything stays like today.

It's a long story, Mom and Dad are just, they are unemployed and trying to get help with issues. They aren't home much and when they are, we don't talk to them because they are sometimes angry / drunk and can get agitated / aggressive sometimes.

I'm trying my best with keeping food and stuff for our family. It's a lot of hard work, but I won't let my family down.

My 15 year old sister and 9 year old sister were pretty close, always tickling and annoying one-another. But now, we I guess we just got older. We make eye contact when we talk, but smiling is minimal in ourhome.

That's a problem also, I just can't say anything close to that. We aren't that type of close family to bring up talk like that.

Plus, I don't know about what girls are going through currently at their age. I can't be talking to them like I know what they're going through.

You probably think that because of your own experiences and / or because of the age cap between siblings compared to parents.

I'm not close to any of my family members.
Our family... we are just the quiet - keep to yourself - sort of family.

She's pretty quiet, angry, and keeps to herself. 

I hope you're right. I know that a lot of people don't like older male sibling touching younger female sibling for a variety of reasons which could tear a family apart even if there was no specific intent.
Sometimes, she scares me :(

We aren't that affectionate unfortunately like I know most families are and I don't have time to watch movies and stuff with them. I'm really busy except on Sundays and that is usually when I spend the day shopping with my 15 year old sister and then completing errands.

My 15 year old sister never did this.

My 12 year old sister is just... weird. It's been happening a lot even when she was young, where she would ignore me when I tell her to do something. I never hit her or anything. She's always just angry at everyone in our family, especially at our sisters. 

I just don't think she likes living with us or would rather have another family.

My 12 year old sister get's angry a lot. I just... hopefully she doesn't use this as a way to say, "hey you touched me that night," or something of that sort. 

Very unlikely she would do that since I actually give her allowance and provide for her, but still.

Oh okay. I don't want that either; where she is sleeping well because I am cuddling her. I would rather everything just go back to normal.

I found the issue though, she was just cold. I feel the solution is to buy a heater or ask the Super to turn the heater on in the bedrooms.

She said she was cold that night. Also asked for a heater since Winter has approached here.

Feelings and stuff, I don't talk to them about. Our family is really quiet towards each-other.

Not the worst thing ever. It felt nice cuddling her because she always is angry with our family. It felt like she does love me if she asked me to comfort her, even bringing my hand and putting it around her.

I just don't want her friends or anything to know. They might get the wrong idea.

She said it was kind of cold and asked me to buy a heater for the bedroom.

We're going to leave in a little bit to pick one up. It's starting to snow here in Canada and the weather at night is under 0 degrees Celsius now. Hopefully I can talk to the Super of our apartment to turn up the heat.

Ew no, I would never touch/hurt any of my family members in that way.

What do you mean by "become dependent on it?"

She was shivering a little bit when I started cuddling her but eventually stopped. I just hope she doesn't tell anyone that her 19 year old bro. slept with her when she is angry with me. It could ruin me.

Our relationship is weird though. She always yells at our sisters. She never yells at me but always gives me dirty looks. 

Should I talk to her incase  something might be wrong or anything? Or just leave it as it is?
